text:
Ethan (Support): Quick escalation — ACME Corp blocked on onboarding: SSO test fails with 403 during token exchange. Theyre on trial, high potential ARR, customer is waiting. Need CS to take a priority handoff.
Priya (CS Manager): Thanks @Ethan — assigning CS to own the comms. Can you paste the exact error and repro steps?
Ethan (Support): Logs attached below, repro steps included.
```
2026-03-21T14:02:11Z ERROR auth: token exchange failed status=403 body="invalid_assertion"
request_id=req-8a9f
```
Repro: 1) create tenant 2) upload SAML metadata 3) click Test SSO -> 403. Customer uses Okta + custom domain.
Marco (Solutions Eng): I can take triage. Sounds like SP metadata or attribute mapping. Quick question: are they on Hosted or Dedicated? @Ethan
Ethan (Support): Hosted (trial). Also saw intermittent 401s prior to the 403.
Priya (CS Manager): High-level plan: 1) Triage call with customer + Marco (Solutions) today EOD 2) Provide temporary manual-invite workaround to avoid onboarding stall 3) Capture feedback and update onboarding docs 4) Schedule enablement session next week to cover SSO best practices. Marco, take triage lead. Lina, please prep enablement one-pager.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Taking triage lead. I'll attempt key re-sync and validate SP metadata. ETA ~2 hours to confirm root cause. If I can't fix, will escalate to eng-runtime.
Lina (Enablement): I'll book a 45m enablement session (Mon 10am PT) and prepare a short checklist + one-pager about common SSO pitfalls. I'll put the slides in the onboarding playbook and add a feedback section for ACME.
Priya (CS Manager): Comms plan (internal + external): - External: email to ACME with triage window and temporary invite instructions. - Internal: post triage recap to #customer-success and ping sales + support. - Risk: mark renewal risk if unresolved by Friday and notify Jordan.
Jordan (Customer Success Director): Marking priority-high. If triage doesn't resolve within 24h, escalate to eng-runtime and loop in security for token failure analysis. Also schedule a renewal check-in call to keep rapport.
Ethan (Support): I'm sending the temporary invite instructions to the customer now and sharing the triage calendar invite.
AccountBot: Reminder: created ticket CS-3023, priority: high, assignees: Marco, Priya, Lina.
Priya (CS Manager): Owners confirmed — Solutions lead: Marco, CS lead: Priya, Enablement: Lina. Action items added to CS-3023. We'll capture customer feedback during the enablement and update onboarding docs. Please reply in-thread with any blocker updates. :thumbsup:
